❌ Local flights out of Dulles? More expensive.

It’s not fiscal responsibility — it adds 6 trillion to the debt. I’m fighting back to protect Virginia families who deserve better.

🚨largest cut to health benefits and food assistance in American history 
🚨increases the debt by $6 trillion
🚨gives tax cuts to wealthiest corporations https://t.co/5C8awKmwE7

From making it harder to get student loans, to stripping those most in need of their health care access, to wasting $100 million in taxpayer dollars to move our space shuttle out of VA to Texas, everyone can find something to not like about this bill.
